title: Preserve fail-closed recovery when GitHub PR comment API denies the required owner handoff
root_cause: Production Required Gate Watchdog requested issues:write but only pull-requests:read; GitHub returned 403 Resource not accessible by integration to POST /issues/4656/comments, aborting all remaining watchdog work after successful #4662 missing-gate dispatch. Actual provider PR-comment capability is not yet independently proven.
impact: A single unauthorized owner comment terminates the existing 5-minute watchdog and prevents independent pending Required recovery; no owner handoff receipt.
fix: Request pull-requests:write for PR comment authority; detect typed PR-comment 401/403, record immutable failure context, bound attempts to two per invocation, keep independent missing-Required dispatch running and fail the watchdog job whenever a handoff was denied.
prevention_rule: A scheduled watcher must preflight GitHub PR-comment authority, consider only provider-acknowledged comments delivered, never let one blocked comment stop independent recovery, and never mark a partial denied tick green. Reuse one scheduler and same canonical Brain fingerprint.
